metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the reading at Holywell, and an afternoon at home from the Shrew.

yesterday: Twenty-three rolls, six days, in one hand. Peter was read flat on purpose.
Pope has the Nurse from the first speech. Richard was silent until he said he is seven-and-twenty, and you told him to play the lover at a run. Nick marked his roll.
Kemp's count is nine-and-twenty lines, a fan, and half a song. Saturday supper is asked, and you are still on you with him.
You stayed home from this afternoon's Shrew. The Rose had Barnardo.
Tomorrow morning is Navarre. At half past eleven you are at Field's for a quire.
